inlines.v: BOOTH, noun [Heb. beth, a house or booth a nest for birds.] A house or shed built of boards, boughs of trees, or other slight materials, for a temporary residence. BOOT'-HOSE, noun [boot and hose.] Stocking-hose or spatterdashes, in lieu of boots.
